name: fastapi-sqlite-api
scaffold_command: uv init --name app -q && uv add fastapi 'uvicorn[standard]' -q && uv add --dev pytest httpx -q && mkdir -p app tests && : > app/__init__.py && printf 'def test_placeholder():\n    assert True\n' > tests/test_placeholder.py

file_manifest.purpose: Empty package marker so `app` is importable. Nothing else belongs here.

SQLite persistence, standard-library sqlite3 only, no ORM. `DB_PATH` defaults to './app.db' and is read from the LOOM_DB_PATH env var so tests can point it at a temp file. `connect() -> sqlite3.Connection` opens DB_PATH with `row_factory = sqlite3.Row` and `PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON`. `init_db()` creates the schema if absent (idempotent — use `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS`). `get_conn()` is a FastAPI dependency that yields a connection and closes it in a finally block. Parameterise every query; never build SQL by string concatenation.

The FastAPI application. `app = FastAPI(title=...)`, calls `init_db()` on a startup event. Defines one Pydantic model per request body and one per response, and the REST endpoints the PRD lists, each using `Depends(get_conn)`. Create returns 201 with the created resource; a lookup that finds nothing raises `HTTPException(status_code=404)`; malformed bodies are left to FastAPI's automatic 422. No business logic in the route bodies beyond calling into small helpers.

pytest suite using `fastapi.testclient.TestClient`. A fixture sets LOOM_DB_PATH to a tmp_path file and calls `init_db()` so every test runs against a fresh database. Cover: creating a resource returns 201 and echoes it back; listing then contains it; fetching a missing id returns 404; a request that violates the schema returns 422. Delete tests/test_placeholder.py, which the scaffold created only so the empty suite would pass.
What the API is, how to run it (`uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload`), and one curl example per endpoint that actually works against the running server.

criteria.name: tests
criteria.description: The project's own test suite passes.

criteria.name: app_boots
criteria.description: The application imports and constructs without a database or import error.
criteria.command: uv run python -c "from app.main import app; assert app.title"

criteria.name: serves_openapi
criteria.description: An acceptance check written with the rubric, not the model: the app actually serves over HTTP and publishes a schema. Weakening the project's own tests cannot make this pass.
criteria.command: uv run python -c "from fastapi.testclient import TestClient; from app.main import app; r = TestClient(app).get('/openapi.json'); assert r.status_code == 200, r.status_code; assert r.json()['paths']"
